NONE: › the job or activity of correcting the position of teeth and dealing with and preventing problems of the teeth
正牙，齒科矯正，齒列矯正
› a person whose job is to correct the position of the teeth
正牙醫生，齒科矯正醫生
C2 (of beliefs, ideas, or activities) considered traditional, normal, and acceptable by most people
（信仰、觀點或活動）正統的，傳統的，普遍接受的
C2 (of religious people) having more traditional beliefs than other people in the same religious group
（宗教信徒）正統派的
› a part of the Christian Church, with many members in Greece, Russia, and eastern Europe
（希臘／俄羅斯／東）正教

example: We would prefer a more orthodox approach/solution to the problem.
我們願意用一種更為正統的方法處理／解決該問題。

NONE: › the use of drugs and operations to cure illness
正統醫學

example: She is a cancer sufferer who has rejected orthodox medicine and turned instead to acupuncture and other forms of alternative medicine.
她這個癌症患者已經摒棄了正統治療方法，轉而求助於針灸及其他替代療法。

C: › [ C ] the generally accepted beliefs of society at a particular time
正統觀念，普遍接受的觀念
C or U: › [ C or U ] the traditional beliefs of a religious group or political party
（宗教團體或政黨的）正統信仰
U: › [ U ] the degree to which someone believes in traditional religious or political ideas
（對傳統宗教或政治觀點的）信奉程度

example: The current economic orthodoxy is of a free market and unregulated trade.
當前的正統經濟觀念主張自由市場和無約束貿易。
She is a strict defender of Catholic orthodoxy.
她是正統天主教的絕對捍衛者。
His orthodoxy began to be seriously questioned by his parish priest.
教區牧師開始對他信教的虔誠度產生了深深的懷疑。

NONE: › relating to an angle of 90 degrees, or forming an angle of 90 degrees
直角的，正交的，垂直的
› the accepted way of spelling and writing words
正確拼寫；正字法
› relating to orthopaedics
整形的，矯形的
› designed to prevent or treat bone injuries
用於矯形的

example: 矯形外科醫生／專家／醫院

NONE: › the treatment or study of bones that have not grown correctly or that have been damaged
矯形外科（學），整形外科（學）
› relating to standing up straight
直立的

example: If you feel that your blood pressure changes because of the posture and position you are holding, you may be suffering from orthostatic hypotension.
如果你覺得你的血壓因你的身體姿態和位置而改變，你有可能患有起立性低血壓。
